title: Build Webhook Payload Visual Inspector Plugin
description: PostHog settings panel currently lacks a visual inspector for project webhooks. Build a clean React payload viewer component that polls webhook log API, renders JSON side-by-side, and includes re-delivery action.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Scaffold Next.js dashboard UI. Hour 2-3: Connect PostHog API & JSON tree component. Hour 4: Deploy Vercel demo & submit PR.

title: Create Next.js Realtime Storage Bandwidth Meter Widget
description: Developers need a lightweight storage meter widget for Supabase projects to visualize bucket egress in real-time.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Next.js setup with Recharts. Hour 2-3: Supabase JS SDK storage events integration. Hour 4: Live demo submission.

title: Superteam Solo Developer Bounties & Builder Grants
description: Active solo builder bounties and micro-grants for building frontend web apps, API integrations, and developer tools.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Choose active open bounty on Superteam Earn. Hour 2-4: Build Next.js UI integration. Hour 5-6: Submit proof of work & claim cash.

title: Coolify Cloud Deployment Status Notification Extension
description: Build an open-source visual status widget for Coolify instance health, monitoring container CPU/RAM and triggering Slack webhooks.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Next.js status page boilerplate. Hour 2-3: Coolify API polling adapter. Hour 4: Vercel demo & PR submission.

title: Kubernetes Pod Metrics Visual Timeline Component
description: Build a React Gantt-chart timeline component for Devtron dashboard parsing Kubernetes pod deployment logs into step-by-step visual bars.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: React log parser component. Hour 2-4: Timeline chart rendering with Tailwind. Hour 5-6: Devtron PR submission.

title: Appsmith Custom Widget Integration & Extension
description: Build a custom React chart widget extension for Appsmith low-code platform allowing 1-click JSON export for Indian enterprise users.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Set up Appsmith custom widget SDK. Hour 2-4: Build React chart component. Hour 5: Submit PR on GitHub.
